profile.headline: Independent Web Developer
profile.summary: As the founding member at Foresight Marketing, I get to help local businesses grow digitally by generating better leads, increasing sales conversion, as well as pre-qualifying customers right on your website.                 I started my journey as a freelance finance broker. Doing web design was just to have fun and make some extra money, but now its my business and passion. Connect with me to learn how your company can be profiting from a modern website that's designed to generate and appeal to more customers.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I've worked to develop websites for this company for the past 3 months. I've been working to bring high end websites to smaller businesses in the local area. Each of these websites are unique to the businesses they are built for. My goal is to provide a digital presence for my community, that they can be proud of.
positions.insights: WordPress, Wix Website Builder and +1 skill

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Foresight Marketing will allow your business to grow and expand through organic traffic and sales conversion!  With our smooth design and expansive optimization, we deliver a premium online experience that is sure to web traffic and sales conversion. As well as that, we provide interactive live chats that can substitute for human assistance! 

With all this, you'll be on your way to success. To stay on that path you'll need protection to keep your information and website safe, which we also provide!

Remember to contact us, so we can develop a plan that will take your online business to the next level.
